text: {"sql":"SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, SUM(oi.amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
